secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: Stripe API secret key (sk_live_… or sk_test_…). Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <secretKey>'.

webhookSecret.title: Webhook Signing Secret
webhookSecret.description: Endpoint signing secret (whsec_…) used to verify inbound webhook signatures. This is the only trust anchor for the webhook endpoint.

publishableKey.title: Publishable Key
publishableKey.description: Publishable key (pk_live_… or pk_test_…). Safe to expose to a frontend.

allowedReturnOrigins.title: Allowed Return Origins
allowedReturnOrigins.description: Origins a checkout or billing-portal return URL may point at, e.g. https://app.example.com. Anything else is rejected — this is what stops a caller redirecting a paying member to an attacker-controlled page.
